scripts.setup: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown aarch64-apple-ios aarch64-apple-ios-sim x86_64-apple-ios && cargo install wasm-pack --version 0.14.0 --locked && cargo install cargo-packager --locked
scripts.check:fast: bun run fmt:check && bun run clippy && bun run test && bun run check:wasm && bun run build:web
scripts.check:ci: bun run check:fast && cargo check -p memory_pak_app --release
scripts.build:ios: platform/ios/generate.bash && xcodebuild -project platform/ios/MemoryPak.xcodeproj -scheme MemoryPak -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
